propositions: _paged_search has no offset-stall guard and spins unbounded when a DC server ignores/repeats startAt, returning the same page repeatedly instead of terminating
get_parent_map wraps _paged_search in a bare except-all handler that converts any raised stall signal into a silent empty-dict degradation, neutralizing the transport-layer abort

fetch_snapshot's three whole-project enrichment handlers (issuelink, comment, parent) contain broad exception handlers that swallow the stall error unless re-raised, writing degraded snapshots instead of failing loudly
the stall error must be defined in core _backend.py (not as an adapter-local error) so that both the DC adapter and fetcher can name it without layering inversion
_paged_search must raise on ANY repeated page (short or full), diverging from fetcher._iter_pages which passes on short pages, because DC's hardened pagination caps every page short by design
